Notes_and_Tips: Keep meal timing regular to support thyroid function.
Stress and late nights trigger sweet and fried cravings; start meals with protein and eat slowly.
Keep rice portions small and consistent across meals.
Prefer pan fried or pressure cooked foods with minimal oil.
Try light movement after dinner to improve sleep quality.
Focus on steady routine and energy improvements rather than quick weight loss.
